14.constraint: Use this muted-olive clean sleeveless top once only for Spring/Summer Casual Everyday, Travel, Resort, Festival or a restrained daytime Party look. Keep the outfit modern with one controlled straight or tailored bottom in ecru, stone, tobacco, washed blue or soft black and a low-profile cream, tan or white shoe; never combine it with a puddled wide leg, another oversized layer, a bulky sneaker or an all-dark palette.

16.constraint: Use this coffee-brown regular-relaxed heavyweight-look T-shirt once only for Spring/Summer Casual Everyday, Date Night, Travel, Weekend or a restrained Party look. Balance its dropped shoulder with a clean straight, tapered or tailored bottom in ecru, stone, sage, light blue or charcoal and a cream, tan or white low-profile shoe; never add a baggy or puddled bottom, another oversized layer, a chunky trainer or a head-to-toe dark palette.

rejectionGroups.reason: These long-sleeve henley and performance tops are overlong, narrow, chest-emphasizing or sleeve-heavy and recreate the rejected skinny-top direction.
These tops rely on visible logos, outlined graphics, pseudo-brand styling or dark novelty decoration instead of a clean modern garment.
These hanger-only or product-only tops do not prove credible adult shoulder, torso, sleeve, hem and movement proportions.
The Chinese-style button shirt reads costume-like and dated rather than versatile modern menswear.
The smooth synthetic-looking fitted tee is visually generic, torso-emphasizing and weaker than the accepted regular-relaxed T-shirt options.
The long active tank has oversized arm openings, repeated performance styling and a weaker everyday silhouette than the cleaner sleeveless top accepted in this batch.
These pleated trousers are extremely wide, ballooned or puddled over the shoe and directly violate the controlled straight or tailored silhouette requirement.
The below-knee cargo short is oversized, pocket-heavy and styled as bulky streetwear rather than a clean modern summer bottom.
The plaid polo-and-shorts set is a weak product-only composite with long shorts and dated matched-set detailing.
These faux-leather motorcycle jackets are shiny, tight, heavily detailed, logo-led or dated and do not meet the premium modern outerwear gate.
These puffers are repetitive, bulky, product-only, contrast-trimmed or generic dark technical layers without a distinctive modern role.

qaSummary: 40 identities and all 155 recorded color images rendered; 155 displayed images loaded with zero broken files.
2 accepted with one exact color and variant selected each: a muted-olive clean sleeveless top and a coffee-brown regular-relaxed T-shirt.
38 rejected after the base pass and close inspection of 20 promising color variants across five identities; every bottom and outerwear product failed.
Every selected identity, source product, variant and image has zero collision with every prior accepted or conditional item.
Rejections include skinny or logo-led tops, insufficient fit proof, ultra-wide puddled trousers, oversized cargo shorts, dated faux leather and repetitive puffers.
